name: 07-10-vnpay-card-channel
title: Allow VNPAY card-channel testing
description: Allow the shared VNPAY provider to select a configured payment channel such as VNBANK for sandbox card testing without changing the existing GraphQL or REST contracts.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Shared VNPAY provider now includes configured VNPAY_BANK_CODE in the signed URL and leaves it absent by default. GitHub CI passed backend lint/tests/build and frontend conflict, lint, unit, changed-component, build, and smoke checks. No live VNPAY transaction was executed.
